job.job_description:
Job Summary

Role: AI Engineer / Intern Business-Embedded AI Team

Company: Omozing, Powered by Aparampaar Finance (RBI-Registered NBFC)

Location: Bangalore Omozing Office (In-Office Only)

Duration: Full-Time Role / Paid Internship (2-3 Months)

No. of Positions: 5

Omozing, a next-gen fintech powered by Aparampaar Finance (NBFC), is looking for smart, analytical, and tech-driven Software Programmers to join our fast-growing team in Bangalore. We build AI-powered financial solutions for salaried individuals across India.

Whether you're a fresher or have up to 2 years of experience, this is your opportunity to build real products, gain domain exposure, and work closely with our tech leadership team.

Why Join Omozing

If you're ready to jump into the world of technology, develop new skills, and gain industry experience, we'd love to have you on board!

Location: View Office on Google Maps

Role Responsibilities
AI Automation Projects: Contribute to building OCR modules, face match systems, automated credit checks, fraud detection algorithms, and more.
Web App Development: Build and maintain scalable components for our web and mobile platforms (Flutter, React Native, Node.js, etc.)
API Integrations: Connect with credit bureaus, KYC partners, payment gateways, and internal systems via REST APIs.
Data Engineering Reporting: Support reporting pipelines, credit analytics, and business dashboards using SQL, Excel, or Python.
Who should apply
Freshers with excellent academic records or from premium engineering colleges
Recent grads with Python, Node.js, React, API-building experience
Engineers with 0-3 yrs experience in AI automation or internal tools
Strong GitHub/project portfolio. We're listening.
Opportunity to work on AI-first financial products
Mentorship from senior developers and data scientists
Dynamic, mission-driven fintech environment
Potential full-time conversion after internship
Exposure to NBFC operations, credit tech, and regulatory fintech


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
